description: An object that assembles a complex value step by step and returns it from `build()`.
Encoding an object's state in its type, so methods are only callable in valid states and invalid sequences fail to compile.
A type parameter no member uses. Structural typing ignores it, so it gives no protection: make it appear in a member signature.
`build(...args: Ready extends true ? [] : [missing: 'Missing step: url'])`: the call compiles only in the right state and the error names what is missing.
`[X] extends [never] ? A : B` wraps the checked type in a tuple so a union is tested as a whole instead of member by member.
Each step returns a new builder with copied state, so earlier builders keep their type and value and can be safely reused as bases.
